references.text: Ezion-Geber is mentioned as the place where King Solomon built ships. This highlights the site's strategic importance on the Red Sea.
Ezion-Geber is mentioned again in connection with King Jehoshaphat's fleet, which was built there. This confirms the site's role as a port city.
Ezion-Geber is mentioned together with Elath as cities by the sea in the land of Edom, where Solomon received ships from Hiram.
Ezion-Geber is mentioned as the place where Jehoshaphat made an alliance with Ahaziah to build ships.
It describes the Israelites' journey past Elath and Ezion-Geber on their way through the wilderness to Moab.
